Class TermIndex

java.lang.Object
network.ike.docs.plugin.registry.TermIndex
public final class TermIndex extends Object
The term index IKE-INDEX.md and IKE-TOPIC-REGISTRY.md describe, term-index.yaml: the reverse mapping from the index terms a topic marks (indexterm:[primary, secondary], indexterm2:[term], ((term)), (((primary, secondary)))) to the topics that mark them. The registry's keywords say what a topic is about; its index terms say what it discusses.

Terms are collected once, when a topic is parsed, and kept on its registry entry as index-terms, each level joined with " > "; the index is then derived from the registry alone, so an incremental registry run never reopens a file to rebuild it (IKE-Network/ike-issues#1341).

  • Method Details

    • termsOf

      public static List<String> termsOf(String content)
      The index terms one file marks, in order of appearance, each as its levels joined with LEVEL_SEPARATOR; a term marked twice is listed once. A visible term, ((term)), is one level; a concealed one, (((primary, secondary))), splits on commas as indexterm:[] does. Lines that are comments are passed over.
      Parameters:
      content - the file content
      Returns:
      the terms, empty when the file marks none

    • model

      public static Map<String,Object> model(Map<String,Object> registry, Instant now)
      The term index as an ordered map, ready for YAML, from a registry model whose topic entries carry index-terms: generated, term-count, then terms, a tree of levels in alphabetical order, each level with its _topics in id order and its sub-levels after.
      Parameters:
      registry - the registry model, from TopicRegistry.model or TopicRegistry.load
      now - the generation instant, recorded as a date
      Returns:
      the term index model
